Ring-by-ring classification of cavity origin is qualitative with no quantitative model comparison
Hyper-parameters of Frankenstein chosen by visual inspection, which introduces subjectivity in ring contrast

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly several hundred GB to about 1 TB of raw ALMA data across 14 ALMA projects, plus VLA calibrated data; self-calibrated continuum subsets are much smaller (tens of GB)
reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public and the main modeling steps (Frankenstein hyper-parameters, SED model, ranges, MCMC sizes, flux errors) are given, but initial calibration, imaging masks, line-free channels and several priors are unstated, and the work spans 26 datasets.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA and VLA data, a mostly complete visibility-modeling and SED-fitting recipe, and numeric outputs (ring radii, dust masses, free-free fluxes), though it is a heavy multi-dataset job.
